title: Create task list endpoint
instruction: Write a FastAPI app with an in-memory list `items` and a GET endpoint at `/items` that returns the list. Start with two initial items: 'Learn Python' and 'Build API'.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API"]

# Your code here

title: Add POST to create items
instruction: Extend the previous app by adding a POST endpoint at `/items` that accepts a JSON body with an `item` field and appends it to the list. Return the updated list with status 201.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API"]

class NewItem(BaseModel):
    item: str

# Add POST endpoint here

title: Add DELETE endpoint
instruction: Extend the app with a DELETE endpoint at `/items/{index}` that removes an item by its list index. Return a 404 if the index is out of range.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API", "Deploy"]
